card.name: Guidelines split after dosage headings
card.fires_on: The word piece "Guid" or "GUID" that starts "guidelines" or "guided" right after a dosage or titration heading. It is strongest in all-caps headings like DOSAGE GUIDELINES.

modes.label: Dosage guidelines heading
modes.description: The start of GUIDELINES in an all-caps heading after DOSAGE or a similar phrase.

modes.label: Guided by (titration)
modes.description: The start of "Guided" after a dose adjustment or titration heading.
